reimbursement_policies.evidence: Serum alpha-1 antitrypsin quantification is reimbursable only when the member has a listed indication, including liver disease, pulmonary disease, neonatal cholestasis, vasculitis, necrotizing panniculitis, or qualifying family history.

reimbursement_policies.evidence: This payer reimburses hepatic fibrosis multianalyte assay testing for specified liver conditions, including alcoholic hepatitis, when billed no more than once every 180 days.

recommended_action.description:
Recommendation 1: Apply a Medicare Advantage code-pairing edit so 82103 and 82104 are allowed only in the same diagnostic workup. Peer: UHC and Humana both scope these laboratory guardrails to Medicare Advantage, supporting a Medicare Advantage-first deployment..

IA — Implement a Medicare Advantage utilization edit for 81517, 81596, 0002M, 0003M, 0166U, 0344U, and 0468U that allows 1 unit per 180 days for hepatitis B, hepatitis C, MASLD, MASH, or alcoholic hepatitis, per member regardless of billing provider and per member regardless of rendering provider. UHC and Humana both scope these laboratory guardrails to Medicare Advantage, supporting a Medicare Advantage-first deployment..
